notifications.permissionDenied: macOS notifications are off. Open System Settings to allow them.

@notifications.permissionDenied.description: Info toast shown once when the user has denied Cmdr permission to send macOS notifications, so a notification couldn't be shown. Points them to System Settings to re-enable. "System Settings" is Apple's app, and macOS localizes its name: use the one your language's macOS shows (check the reference pile or the app bundle).
